_comment: Modules that call a model endpoint (chat/completions, /completions, /v1/responses) directly over HTTP, frozen so the set cannot grow (#36, invariant 2). This is an inventory, not a verdict: maistro.providers is a registry with no HTTP client, so there is no approved Provider implementation for these to be outside of yet -- #56 builds it, and deciding which of these are providers, adapters or escapes is that issue's adjudication. Enforced by scripts/check-model-egress.py, which ratchets both ways: a new direct caller fails, and an entry that stops calling out fails until pruned, so a migration shrinks this file.
